arguments.value: Fruit of Life Productions LLC (the Promoter) and Eco Science Solutions, Inc. (the Sponsor) entered into a sponsorship agreement for Kaya Fest, effective April 1, 2018, under which Eco Science Solutions, Inc. agreed to pay $250,000 in full when the agreement was signed in exchange for sponsor recognition and event benefits such as main stage naming rights, vendor booths, tickets, parking passes, banners, logo placement, and promotional mentions. The agreement ran through April 30, 2018. Fruit of Life Productions LLC kept all rights to Kaya Fest branding and intellectual property, and Eco Science Solutions, Inc. could not use that property to imply endorsement without written approval. The Sponsor also had to indemnify the Promoter, keep certain information confidential, and carry $1 million in liability insurance if exhibiting. The parties were independent contractors, disputes were to be handled by arbitration with no jury trial, and the agreement was governed by the laws of the State of Florida.
